_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Nondestructive Inspection (NDI) Program Plan
summary: The Nondestructive Inspection (NDI) Program Plan defines requirements for an NDI program applicable to structural components for aircraft, missiles, and related systems throughout all phases of the system lifecycle.
use_relationship:
The Nondestructive Inspection (NDI) Program Plan will be applicable to any system acquisition that includes a requirement for an NDI program and shall be used for structural components for aircraft, missiles and related systems and critical components produced by the contractor, subcontractors and suppliers. The NDI program plan shall address all phases of the system lifecycle to include NDI requirements during development, test, demonstration, production and sustainment phases.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the technical requirements described in 5.1.6 of MIL-STD-1530 (USAF), Aircraft Structural Integrity Program (ASIP).

(Copies of this document are available online at http://quicksearch.dla.mil.)

preparation_instructions.content: The plan shall be in the contractor's format

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content:
The specific approaches used for NDI of the system shall be documented utilizing the requirements in MIL-STD-1530 (USAF). Additional guidance for NDI Program Plans can be found in MIL-HDBK-6870, DoD Nondestructive Inspection Program Requirements for Aircraft and Missile Materials and Parts. The NDI Program Plan shall present the scheme for establishing the NDI requirements and implementing procedures to meet these requirements.

(Copies of this document are available at http://quicksearch.dla.mil.)
